# bigseek-js
> A browser client for Bigseek indexes with a CJK bigram tokenizer and optional MiniSearch fallback.
Canonical project page: https://projects.imba97.dev/projects/bigseek-js/
GitHub: https://github.com/imba97/bigseek-js
Status: documented candidate
Last verified: 2026-11-17
